scientific_limitations: Characteristic five only; the three singular parameter fibers are excluded.
A complete 5-rank and a-number classification is proved, not a complete Newton-polygon or Ekedahl--Oort classification.
The classical superspecial Fermat sextic is acknowledged prior knowledge, not claimed original.
Originality comparison is not an exhaustive priority certification; unindexed equivalent derivations may exist.
title: The 5-rank-eight stratum of a symmetric genus-ten plane-sextic family
